title: Alwa market
sub: What farmers put on sale in the Jutyar app, in detail, and the average prices they ask and get. Prices are set by farmers and buyers, not by the government.
not_live: Alwa is not published in the app yet. The listings here are sample data to show how the page will look. Nothing on this page approves, changes or removes a listing.
avg_title: Average prices, IQD per kg (or per tray, litre, head)
avg_note: Asking = the average price on open listings. Sold at = the average price of finished deals. A dash means there is no listing of that kind yet.
sold_chart: Average price per product sold by the kg, IQD per kg
search: Farmer name, phone or listing number
products_live: Product names, groups and units come from the server ({n} products). The listings are sample data.
products_sample: The server's product list could not be read, so the built-in product list is shown.
